title: Daily Briefing — 04 Aug 2026
content:
📰 Daily Briefing — 04 Aug 2026

💼 CAREER (Cybersecurity + Employed Individual)
• Greatness PhaaS Adds Device Code Phishing to Bypass MFA and Steal Tokens — The Greatness phishing-as-a-service toolkit has added support for OAuth 2.0 device code phishing to bypass multi-factor authentication. (The Hacker News)
  🔗 https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/greatness-phaas-adds-device-code.html
• Keyv-Linked npm Worm Poisons Hundreds of Packages, Plants Claude Code and VS Code Hooks — A credential-stealing npm worm poisoned hundreds of packages across multiple organizations by planting malicious Claude Code and VS Code hooks. (The Hacker News)
  🔗 https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/keyv-linked-npm-worm-poisons-hundreds.html
• Google Deletes 3 ADK AI Workflows After Malicious GitHub Issue Could Trigger Privileged Agent — Google removed three Python-based AI agent workflows after researchers demonstrated prompt injection vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues. (The Hacker News)
  🔗 https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/google-deletes-3-adk-ai-workflows-after.html
• Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws — Microsoft released software updates to address 570 security vulnerabilities across Windows operating systems and component software. (Krebs on Security)
  🔗 https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/07/microsoft-patches-a-record-570-security-flaws/
